definitions.monthly_income: AMT_INCOME_TOTAL / 12; form monthly income multiplied by 12 for annual ratios
definitions.loan_amount: AMT_CREDIT; requested cash principal or revolving credit limit
definitions.monthly_payment: AMT_ANNUITY monthly; form cash annuity or revolving principal minimum plus monthly interest estimate
definitions.product: Cash loans -> cash; Revolving loans -> revolving
definitions.employment_type: NAME_INCOME_TYPE; form employment type with identical categories
definitions.bureau_count: Count of external credits with origination and last update no later than original application
definitions.bureau_active_count: External credits labelled Active at the original snapshot
definitions.bureau_debt_sum: Sum of observed external debt; not local platform assets
definitions.bureau_max_dpd: Maximum external credit days overdue at original snapshot
definitions.bureau_overdue_sum: Sum of observed externally overdue amounts
definitions.bureau_late_fraction: Fraction of known numeric bureau statuses that are 1..5; C/X excluded from denominator
definitions.previous_count: Previous applications with DAYS_DECISION <= 0, including unsuccessful applications
definitions.previous_approval_rate: Approved previous applications / all observed previous applications
definitions.previous_recent_count: Previous applications decided between -365 and 0 days
definitions.previous_mean_credit: Mean observed AMT_CREDIT of previous applications; not confirmed disbursements
definitions.pos_late_fraction: POS/cash monthly observations with SK_DPD > 0 / observed months
definitions.card_mean_utilization: Mean observed AMT_BALANCE / positive AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL across historical monthly records
definitions.payment_events: Payment records with actual payment and scheduled due day <= 0; split payments remain distinct events
definitions.payment_late_fraction: Late actual payment events / observed payment events, not installment default rate
definitions.payment_max_lateness: Maximum max(0,DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT-DAYS_INSTALMENT) among eligible actual events
definitions.payment_total_amount: Sum of eligible actual payments, without claiming principal/interest separation
definitions.history_present: 1 when any eligible original history exists, 0 otherwise

cutoff: Original relative application day/month 0. Bureau state requires DAYS_CREDIT<=0 and DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE<=0; historical monthly bureau records are independently restricted to MONTHS_BALANCE<=0. Actual events after 0 excluded. No absolute calendar dates can be reconstructed.
missing: Median imputation fitted inside each training fold; missingness indicators. Unknown categories encoded safely. No blanket zero filling.
history_routing: Only linked original profiles with eligible history use history variant. New/unlinked clients use form variant; local history remains separate.
limitations: Source data is a historical snapshot, not a present-day credit check.
Original dataset does not provide actual interest rates/terms for current applications.
Form installment amounts derive from declared scenario; existing debts and expenses are affordability policy inputs, not ML predictors.
